affinity.title: Cache-aware routing
affinity.description: Prefer a runtime that may still hold a matching prompt prefix, while letting current load override weak matches.
affinity.privacy: Only tenant-scoped HMAC digests and prompt-free routing metadata are stored. A match predicts cache residency; it does not prove it.

capacity.title: Shared local capacity
capacity.description: Keep pools within the real concurrency and context limits of the runtime they share.
capacity.createDescription: Identify one local runtime and set conservative physical limits. You can attach models after saving.
capacity.editDescription: Update the physical limits and runtime identity used for global admission.
capacity.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. Attached models must be reassigned before this capacity can be deleted.
capacity.deleteConflict: This capacity is still attached to one or more models. Reassign them and try again.
capacity.typeName: Type the capacity name to confirm
capacity.empty: No shared capacity is configured. Add one before enabling global admission.
capacity.safeDefaults: Start with one concurrent request and a context limit your runtime can reliably serve. Raise limits after observing stable load.
capacity.poolPolicyHint: Set conservative admission behavior across this pool. {{count}} shared capacities are available for member attachment.
capacity.directGlobalEffect: These settings apply to every direct request sent to this execution target, not only this model entry.
capacity.attachmentGlobalEffect: Changing the shared capacity attachment changes admission for this execution target everywhere it is used.
capacity.borrowIdle: Borrow only while reserved capacity is idle

strategies.template: Use a matching registered tokenizer and template
strategies.engineRequirement: Requires count-token support on the selected target. WSMP uses a conservative estimate when that support is unavailable.
strategies.registeredRequirement: Requires a registered counter matching this runtime identity. WSMP uses a conservative estimate when no match is available.

pools.name: Name
pools.noDirectModels: No direct models are available to add.
pools.optimisticBasicTranscription: Allow unknown members for basic transcription

pools.removeMemberDescription: This model will no longer receive traffic through the pool.
pools.revokeGrantDescription: This user will lose access to the pool model ID.
pools.title: Pools and Grants
pools.transformerCacheHint: OFF keeps descriptions out of cache (best privacy). MEMORY is process-local and only for data: media (not http URLs). Changing descriptions can reduce primary prompt-cache hits.
pools.transformerDescription: Optionally run one OpenAI-compatible model (VLM or media agent) on attachments before the pool’s primary members. Direct models never use a transformer. Only published models that advertise the selected modalities are listed.
pools.transformerIncompatible: Selected model does not support the enabled transformer modalities.
pools.transformerNoEligible: No owned published models advertise the selected modalities (vision/audio/video).

pools.transformerIncludeTools: Forward primary tool names and descriptions

providers.description: Configure external provider accounts, credentials, models, budgets, pricing identity, and the accounting trail used by public overflow.

providers.authTypeImmutable: Authentication type is fixed after the first credential. Create a separate account to change it.

providers.noModels: No models are configured for this account.

providers.unlimitedRuleWarning: Explicitly unlimited; provider and global limits still apply.

providers.unknownCostRows: {{count}} rows have unknown cost or currency and are excluded from known-cost totals.
providers.activePricingRequired: Activate a pricing version before creating a finite spend policy. Its currency is used exactly; currencies are never converted.
providers.poolAttachmentsDescription: Create attachment protection, acknowledge egress for this pool, then attach the enabled model in its explicit fallback order.
